The terminal

spezado tui starts the terminal interface. It works with the keyboard and the mouse: every key shown at the bottom is also a button, rows can be clicked and scrolled. With the mouse on, selecting text needs the modifier key of your terminal; m switches the mouse off.

Moving around

Key  
1 … 8, Tab, Shift-Tab the tabs: Overview, Journal, Bank, Documents, Accounts, Reports, Review, Closing
↑ ↓ the rows of a tab
↵ open the row: a bank entry to book, an account’s ledger, a report
[ ] the year before, the year after
s German or English
m mouse on or off
q, Ctrl-C quit

In a form, ↵, Tab or ↓ go to the next field and ↵ on the last one confirms; Shift-Tab or ↑ go back, ← → change a choice and Esc cancels. An account field searches as you type – by number or name – and ↵ takes the account picked with ↑ ↓. Amounts and dates are written as in the language shown: 1.234,50 and 29.10.2026 in German, 1,234.50 and 2026-10-29 in English. Accounts are given by their number in your chart (4930) – or, for a bank account, by its IBAN.

The tabs

Tab Keys  
Overview n new booking, i read a document, d deadlines, y synchronise (or set it up), v invite a device bank and cash, income, expenses and result of the year, the next advance VAT return and when it is due, open entries, review, the date closed up to, and the relay the books are synchronised through
Journal n new booking, z booking in lines, r reverse every booking; a reversal refers to what it cancels – nothing is changed or deleted
Bank i read a statement, ↵ book, a book all proposals, f fetch the entries of your statements not booked yet, each with a proposal where spezado found one
Documents i read, n new booking, r write an invoice, k new customer, p seller documents with their originals
Accounts ↵ ledger, o opening balances the balance of every account
Reports ↵ open, then e export as CSV, p prepare as a filing; ↵ on a filing submits it or asks where it stands the reports that apply to the year, then the filings (Filings)
Review   what needs review, in words
Closing c close a period, g GoBD data transfer  

A new booking (n) is date, text, account, gross amount, tax code and payment from the bank or the cash: spezado books the net amount, the VAT and the payment. A booking in lines (z) takes lines of account=amount[@code], separated by spaces, positive for debit and negative for credit: 4930=10,00@de-in-19 1576=1,90 1200=-11,90.

Deadlines (d): the state whose public holidays move deadlines (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO) and the permanent extension of advance VAT returns (§ 46 UStDV), from a date on.

Bank proposals come in this order: a payment booked before the statement came (it is booked again on the statement’s bank account, naming the entry), the invoice the entry pays, and the same party’s last entry. A proposal is only a proposal: ↵ shows it to confirm or change.

Fetching from the bank (f) needs a registration as a FinTS product, which spezado does not have yet – read the statement files your bank gives you instead.

Opening balances (o): per account account=amount, holdings positive and debts negative – 1200=3.160,50 1000=200. They are booked once, against the opening balance sheet, and carry on from year to year by themselves.
